cases.sourceText: Stuck with a technology question? Need help with an ongoing issue or learning something new? Stop by the Rinconada branch library for our drop-in tech help Tuesday mornings. Staff is available to help with a variety of tech questions including: Learning to use Libby and/or Hoopla; Accessing library databases and services; Downloading and streaming content; Navigating the City of Palo Alto Library website; Downloading and using the new PACL app; Wi-Fi connection; Printing; Creating an email account; Basic computer skills; Installing and using common apps; And more… Unfortunately, helping you fix damaged hardware or software is not within our scope. Help is given on a first-come, first-served basis. Please bring any devices you use, make sure they are charged, and have your necessary passwords. We look forward to helping you.

cases.reviewed: Stuck with a technology question? Need help with an ongoing issue or learning something new? Stop by the Rinconada branch library for our drop-in tech help Tuesday mornings. Staff can show you how to use Libby or Hoopla, access library databases and services, download and stream content, navigate the City of Palo Alto Library website, and download and use the new PACL app. They can also help with Wi-Fi, printing, setting up an email account, basic computer skills, and installing and using common apps. Unfortunately, helping you fix damaged hardware or software is not within our scope. Help is given on a first-come, first-served basis. Please bring any devices you use, make sure they are charged, and have your necessary passwords. We look forward to helping you.

cases.sourceText: English as a Second Language (ESL) / Learn English: Beyond the Basics is an in-person 7-week class with lessons on English grammar, pronunciation, and idioms. It is for adult (18 years and older) intermediate and advanced English learners who can have a conversation in English and want to improve their pronunciation and understanding. To register for the entire 7-week series, please include your email address and make sure it is entered correctly. Please register only once for the entire series. Registration closes on the 3rd week of class.
